narrative.overview:
The public site is a host UART, not a product hero. The first surface is already printed: a dark bezel, a dim status banner, an honesty line at body size, and one grant typing at full amber. Powers are log lines. Install is a prompt docked on the bottom edge of the first viewport. The world refuses the AI-OS card grid — no icon tiles, no metric row, no marketing display face.

Personality is precise and technical. Density is terminal density: one column, tight line rhythm, generous bezel padding. Aesthetic philosophy is phosphor on a mask, not a themed landing page. Emphasis is intensity and weight, never a second hue or a larger display size. Confirmed visual rejections: card grids, hero metrics, kickers, system display faces, glyph icons, and any gray standing in for dimmed phosphor.
keyCharacteristics: Self-hosted Azeret Mono as the only voice (400, 600, and 700 on the live trace and wordmark)
Two amber intensities: full phosphor for the live trace and wordmark; dim phosphor for history, grants, and chrome
Bezel chassis around a darker glass screen — same brown family, two fills
Chassis sits in a dark void; glass carries a faint tube glow and static scanlines
Install prompt docked to the first-viewport floor

rules.name: The One Live Trace Rule
rules.body: Only the live grant line (prompt, typed text, caret) sits at full phosphor at rest. History, grant log, honesty banner, and chrome stay dim. Hover, focus, and the active language chip may borrow full phosphor or invert; they are states, not a second live trace.

rules.name: The Phosphor Ink Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is dim phosphor. Never introduce gray, cool white, or a second hue to mean “quieter.”

rules.name: The Single Face Rule
rules.body: Azeret Mono is the only voice. Do not add a display pairing or let a system sans become the page voice.

rules.name: The No-Hero Type Rule
rules.body: Headlines stay near body size (1.15rem / 400). The console does not shout with a campaign display size.

rules.name: The Docked Prompt Rule
rules.body: The install (or return) prompt sits on the first-viewport floor, not in a hero CTA cluster.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Running copy and grant lines wrap at 72ch.

rules.name: The Intensity-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Do not halo the whole page. The live grant may bloom; the chassis may sit off the void. History stays flat ink.

rules.name: The Square Terminal Rule
rules.body: No radius. No resting borders. Interaction is outline and intensity, not a filled chip — except the active language control, which inverts dim phosphor onto the mask.

dos: Do keep one live trace at full phosphor and leave history, grants, and chrome dim.
Do dock the primary action to the first-viewport floor with `margin-top: auto`.
Do wrap running copy at 72ch and pad the bezel with `clamp(1rem, 3vw, 1.75rem)`.
Do theme selection, caret, focus rings, and scrollbars from phosphor and mask.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion`: no caret blink, no type-in.
donts: Don't add a second typeface or a display / hero size.
Don't structure a page as a card grid, metric row, or icon-plus-heading tiles.
Don't use gray, cool white, or a second hue for secondary text.
Don't add border-radius, a page-wide halo, or a second hue. The chassis may sit off the void; the live line may bloom.
Don't place a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't use glyph, emoji, or icon-font marks as an icon system.
